[Problem]{.card-kicker} **Minimum number of removals to make a mountain array** [LC 1671 · Minimum Number of Removals to Make Mountain Array](https://leetcode.com/problems/minimum-number-of-removals-to-make-mountain-array/){difficulty="Hard"}

Fewest removals means the longest thing you keep. What you keep is a mountain subsequence: some peak index, a strict increase into it, and a strict decrease out of it. The left arm is an LIS ending at the peak. The right arm is an LIS ending at the peak in the reversed array. Both arms must have length at least 2, otherwise the peak has an empty side.

[Solved in full in @sec-lis-p3-mount.]{.card-link}
